links.function: Fires an urgent distress alarm during the 45 ignored Cyberball throws, scaling directly with how rejected the person feels.
links.narration_bridge: Along the midline, your conflict detector — the anterior cingulate cortex — blazes like a burn alarm.

links.function: Turns social exclusion into physical chest tightness and visceral ache — and quiets down after 3 weeks of central analgesia.
links.narration_bridge: Deep on each side, your body-feeling center — the insula — turns that snub into a real chest ache.

links.function: Steps in to reframe the snub calmly and dial down the anterior cingulate distress signal.
links.narration_bridge: Right behind your eyes, your reality-checker — the ventromedial prefrontal cortex — cools the alarm back down.
